heading_en: Notification Prior to the Application Date Concerning the Special Provision for Exposures to Juridical Persons, etc. Under the Standardized Approach
summary_ja: 標準的手法採用予定の親会社が、適用日前でも法人等向けエクスポージャーの特例を利用する旨の届出をできることを定める。
summary_en: Allows a parent company seeking to adopt the standardized approach to give notice before the Application Date that it will use the special provision for exposures to juridical persons, etc.
paragraphs: A parent company of a financial instruments business operator that intends to become an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach may, even before the Application Date, give notification of its use of the provisions of Article 34, paragraph (1), in accordance with Article 34, paragraph (2).
